title: BIOELECTRIC FENCE
text: Once each turn, after an enemy Character attacks you, deal 1 damage to it.

title: BUS STOP
text: Activate (2) — Exhaust: Return an allied Character to your hand; draw a card.

title: MAILBOX
text: Activate — Exhaust: Roll a D6. On 1–2, do nothing; on 3–4, gain 1 mana; on 5–6, draw a card.

title: PARTICLE EXCHANGER
text: Activate (3) — Exhaust: Return an allied Character to hand. Reveal until you find a Character costing 1 more. Add it to hand; it costs 2 less this turn.

title: REACTIVE CAPACITOR
text: Once each turn, after your opponent plays an Action, gain 1 mana.

title: RECYCLING MACHINE
text: Once each turn, after allied Equipment is destroyed, draw a card.

title: TACTICAL SCANNER
text: Once each turn, after you play your second Action that turn, draw a card.

title: VENDING MACHINE
text: Activate (2) — Exhaust: Heal an allied Character by 2.
